contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 45,628.87' on p3, equal to the cover's Cumulative Totals cell (45,628.87)
contributions.detail: 43 Form A rows (27 on p2 + 16 on p3) sum to 45,628.87 exactly (p2 25,258.87 + p3 20,370.00) = the schedule's printed grand total = the cover's This Report AND Cumulative cells, which are identical on this filing (Totals from Last Report is blank - this is the first 2016 report). 2016 is the 3-line form variant, so there is no separate <=$50 aggregate line: the single contrib_all cell is the anchor. In-kind convention tested: the three filer-labelled in-kind rows (supplies/merchandise donations, 268.88 + 214.56 + 685.44) are INCLUDED - excluding them would leave 44,459.99 and miss the printed total by 1,168.88, so the monetary-plus-in-kind convention is the one that closes.

itemized.notes: 2016 3-line cover variant; office spelled 'COMMISSONER' by the filer. Form A runs p2-p3 (grand total on p3, no per-page subtotal); Form B runs p4-p6 (grand total on p6, no per-page subtotals). Donor and vendor street addresses printed on the schedules are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY: city/state only); a PO box on Form A row 29 likewise. Where donor_state is blank the FILER printed a city and zip with no state - nothing was redacted by the county. On Form A row 40 (Weber County Republican Party) the address cell prints only the words 'Weber County', so both city and state are honestly blank. Form B has its own City column, carried as vendor_city verbatim including the filer's non-city values ('internet', 'CA', 'SLC', 'Clfd', 'MSC'). Three Form A rows carry the filer's own in-kind labels inside the name cell and are included in the printed total, which is what makes the schedule close. This report is an independent third-channel read of the same June-2016 Harvey filing already transcribed from two other channels as keys 1813f430 and 8876cae9; it was transcribed WITHOUT consulting those records, and a rollup must count the report once.
